offering_description.value: Provides safety, fire protection, and specialty contracting services for commercial, industrial, and institutional buildings and facilities. Sells installation, inspection, testing, and maintenance services, along with equipment and parts, to building owners, developers, and general contractors, delivered through a network of local branch offices.

primary_products.value: fire sprinkler and suppression systems; fire alarm and detection equipment; HVAC equipment; plumbing fixtures; electrical systems

primary_services.value: fire and life safety inspection; fire protection installation and service; security system installation; mechanical and plumbing contracting; electrical contracting

customer_segment.value: B2B: commercial building owners, developers, general contractors, industrial plants, data centers; B2G: public agencies, municipal and transit facilities, schools

end_markets.value: commercial construction; industrial; healthcare; education; data centers

revenue_model.value: service fees: inspection, testing, and maintenance contracts for safety systems; project or contract: installation and retrofit projects for building systems; product sales: equipment and parts supplied within installation projects
revenue_model.category: service fees; project or contract; product sales

value_chain_position.value: service provider: takes in project and service contracts from building owners and contractors, performs installation and maintenance work

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Europe, and Asia-Pacific

specialization.value: diversified: Safety Services (fire protection, detection, security) and Specialty Services (HVAC, plumbing, electrical, industrial services)

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: contracts won directly with building owners and general contractors; own locations: local branch offices serving regional customers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: fire and life safety codes, electrical and plumbing licensing, and building codes enforced by local authorities
